expected_results: Owner (verified owner of BOTH #46 and #48) can readiness/prepare/confirm/stop; staff-other-tenant, other tenant, member, anonymous and single-account-owner are DENIED fail-closed with value-blind reason codes (no disclosure).

Confirm requires a fresh re-auth proof (re-submitted password verified by check_password) AND a signed single-use confirm token bound to the prepared authorization + owner; tampered/expired/wrong-user/wrong-authz tokens are refused; the password is never stored/logged/echoed/returned.
Caps enforced SERVER-SIDE irrespective of client input: max_volume=0.01, max_orders=1, max_concurrent=1, modify+full_close authority, partial-close EXCLUDED, 15-min window.

DARK: with the flag OFF every readiness/prepare/confirm endpoint returns 503/FEATURE_DARK and creates nothing; production has NO host actuators so confirm fails closed; no arm is ever created on the production path.

Guaranteed teardown: stop disarms + revokes + signed-host-OFF (via actuators) and releases the acceptance lease iff this owner holds it; idempotent; never releases another holder's lease; a failed confirm never revokes the authorization or strands an arm.
Concurrency: a second operator / a concurrent deploy or recovery cannot run during a prepared demo (single KIND_RECOVERY acceptance lease, fail-closed).

The real #46->#48 execution is NOT exercised: production has no host actuators, and the real atomic-arm internals are covered by trade_copier.tests_lifecycle_arming (the arm boundary is mocked here to test orchestration deterministically).
